senses: 1) a town in the mountains of Judah belonging to the same group as Hebron

H6731.def: properly, glistening, i.e. a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright-colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air)
senses: 1b) shining thing (of gold plate on high priest's mitre) (metaph.)
1) a pass going from the shores of the Dead Sea to the wilderness of Judah near Tekoa

H6734.def: a floral or wing-like projection, i.e. a forelock of hair, a tassel

H6735.def: a hinge (as pressed in turning); also a throe (as a phys. or mental pressure); also a herald or erranddoer (as constrained by the principal)
H6735.kjv: ambassador, hinge, messenger, pain, pang, sorrow. Compare {H6736}.

H6736.def: a form (of beauty; as if pressed out, i.e. carved); hence, an (idolatrous) image

H6737.def: to make an errand, i.e. betake oneself
senses: 1) (BDB) (Hithpael) to supply oneself with provisions, take as one's provision
H6737.deriv: a denominative from {H6735} in the sense of ambassador;

H6739.deriv: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to {H6760} in the sense of bowing;

senses: 1) the 2nd wife of Lamech and mother of Tubal-cain, an instructor of every craftsman in bronze and iron

H6742.deriv: from {H6749} in the sense of rolling;

H6743.def: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
senses: 2) to advance, prosper, make progress, succeed, be profitable
2b1) to make prosperous, bring to successful issue, cause to prosper
2b2) to show or experience prosperity, prosper
H6743.kjv: break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, -ously).

senses: 1a2) show prosperity, be prosperous, have success, be successful

H6745.def: something protracted or flattened out, i.e. a platter

H6746.def: something prolonged or tall, i.e. a vial or salt-cellar

H6747.def: something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl; figuratively, the bosom

H6749.def: properly, to tumble down, i.e. settle by awaving motion
